47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dermane Karim (Lorient) was quite harsh and Ruddy Buquet didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

24' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
